title: FoREST: Frame of Reference Evaluation in Spatial Reasoning Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language and vision-language models on ambiguous spatial descriptions to measure their systematic preference for specific spatial perspectives (e.g., intrinsic vs. relative frames of reference). This is measured by calculating the percentage of answers that assume a relative (R%) versus intrinsic (I%) perspective in Question-Answering tasks, as well as evaluating object placement preferences in Text-to-Image generation layouts.
